title: 1-ms field-term peak and trough timing vs peak acceleration and peak velocity
question: Does the 1-ms field term peak at peak acceleration and trough at peak velocity per condition, with an equally flexible spline basis?
headline: NOT SUPPORTED (internal; not in paper). 1-ms field-term trough is not at peak velocity per condition (reach 0.21 vs rest ~0.21, p=0.61); peak test biased by null (Z0 D_peak -0.33), peak hits 3%. Median-curve pattern is a group-average feature.
